name: Phantom Resemblance

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

text:
Frequency once per day

---
Your can now draw from experience to wear any face you remember. When you use Phantom Visage, you gain the effects of a 3rd-rank Illusory Disguise for 1 hour or until you shift back, whichever comes first.
